overview_description.description: Vantage Data Centers develops and operates data center campuses designed to support hyperscalers, cloud providers, and large enterprises. Its services include rack-ready spaces, customizable whitespace, and build-to-suit solutions, accommodating a range of IT infrastructure needs. The company emphasizes features such as power, cooling, security, compliance, connectivity, and sustainability across its facilities. Vantage Data Centers maintains a global presence with campuses in North America, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific, including locations in the United States, Canada, Germany, Ireland, South Africa, Malaysia, and Japan.
